assignments.description: Sets the Account Domain to the domain from the Website, returned by the formDomain formula.
assignments.name: Assign_Domain_from_Website
assignments.label: Assign Domain from Website

Flow.description: Sets the Domain from the Website (everything after "www.") when the Website changes to a new, non-blank value. Edits to the Domain alone are not overwritten, so the Domain can be set manually.

formulas.description: The domain from the Website: everything after "www.", in lower case, with any page path, query string or port (anything from the first / ? # or :) removed so it can be matched to a Lead's Email Domain.
formulas.name: formDomain
formulas.expression: LOWER( LEFT( {!formWebsiteNoWww}, MIN( IF(CONTAINS({!formWebsiteNoWww}, "/"), FIND("/", {!formWebsiteNoWww}) - 1, LEN({!formWebsiteNoWww})), IF(CONTAINS({!formWebsiteNoWww}, "?"), FIND("?", {!formWebsiteNoWww}) - 1, LEN({!formWebsiteNoWww})), IF(CONTAINS({!formWebsiteNoWww}, "#"), FIND("#", {!formWebsiteNoWww}) - 1, LEN({!formWebsiteNoWww})), IF(CONTAINS({!formWebsiteNoWww}, ":"), FIND(":", {!formWebsiteNoWww}) - 1, LEN({!formWebsiteNoWww})) ) ) )

formulas.description: The Website with surrounding spaces removed and any protocol (e.g. https://) stripped off the front.
formulas.name: formWebsiteNoProtocol
formulas.expression: IF( CONTAINS(TRIM({!$Record.Website}), "://"), MID(TRIM({!$Record.Website}), FIND("://", TRIM({!$Record.Website})) + 3, LEN(TRIM({!$Record.Website}))), TRIM({!$Record.Website}) )

formulas.description: The Website without its protocol and with everything up to and including "www." removed. Websites without "www." are returned unchanged.
formulas.name: formWebsiteNoWww

Flow.label: Account - On Update - Before Save
